== Lore ==
{{NPCSprite|Dr. Emmett}} had '''Alatar''' summon an exact copy of a letter that [[The Watcher|Lathrop]] had failed to deliver. This and {{NPCSprite|Udium}}'s dialogue imply that Alatar doesn't originate in Rift Dimension, although it is unknown how he got in.

== Trivia ==
*'''Alatar''' is one of a few NPCs who are not originally from [[Rift Dimension]], alongside {{NPCSprite|Julian}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}}, {{NPCSprite|Dr. Emmett}} and {{NPCSprite|Tel Kar}}.
